# Downloaded 3D learning models

These source models were downloaded for this Unity project and are imported through Unity glTFast (`com.unity.cloud.gltfast`). The Smithsonian models below are low-resolution GLB variants to keep the project size and runtime cost reasonable.

| File | Use | Source and rights |
|---|---|---|
| `NASA/Earth.glb` | Earth exhibit | [NASA Earth 3D model](https://science.nasa.gov/learn/heat/resource/earth-3d-model/). Credit NASA/JPL-Caltech as noted on the source page; follow [NASA media usage guidelines](https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/). |
| `Smithsonian/Triceratops.glb` | Dinosaur / paleontology exhibit | [Smithsonian Triceratops model](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/triceratops-horridus-marsh-e9c507f179ed4455aac3b208c9e6c973). Smithsonian Open Access / CC0. |
| `Smithsonian/Fern_Cyathea_furfuracea.glb` | Plant diversity exhibit | [Smithsonian Open Access 3D collection](https://3d.si.edu/); model record: `3d_package:4ad9717b-8c81-4b9d-a843-025a60785170`. Open Access. |
| `Smithsonian/George_Washington_Bust.glb` | Museum portrait exhibit | [Smithsonian George Washington Bust](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/george-washington-bust-23630d35f855409e9c00c810b1416c71). Smithsonian Open Access / CC0. |
| `Smithsonian/Apollo_11_Command_Module.glb` | Spaceflight history exhibit | [Smithsonian Open Access 3D collection](https://3d.si.edu/); model record: `3d_package:d8c63e8a-4ebc-11ea-b77f-2e728ce88125`. Open Access. |

The Smithsonian states that designated Open Access digital assets are CC0; see its [Open Access FAQ](https://www.si.edu/openaccess/faq). NASA asks users to follow its media usage guidelines and provide appropriate credit. These files are embedded project assets, not a standalone redistributed asset pack.

Current continuation: these models are now referenced by the exhibit system and are present in the 22 October 2026 candidate's packed-asset report. The original statement that they had not yet been placed is obsolete. The source links above are transferred provenance notes; they do not recreate the missing original download receipts or certify every legacy asset.
